content.value: A ride-sharing company collects trip data including time, location, driver, customer, (13) [CO3] and ride type information. Design a star schema for this system using the following:
Dimensions: Time, Location, Driver, Customer, Ride Type
Clearly identify the fact table and all dimension tables with appropriate attributes.
